what_happened: The job to break up the 205-line status function in status.rs was rejected at the final verdict. Two findings were major and there were no blockers. First, status.rs is still over the 2000-production-line file limit after the change, so the file is not within its limits as the request asked. Second, the accepted reading did not match the request, so passing criteria did not show the request was met. No acceptance criteria are listed as unmet and no checks are listed as failed.
cause: The reading was accepted without being checked against the request's stated outcome (the file under its size limits) or against the current size of status.rs. The reading focused on the one named function, so its criteria checked that the function was split, not that the file was under the limit. Nothing measures the file's size against the limit before the reading is accepted or before the producer finishes. A passing set of criteria therefore proved little, and the gap showed up only when the verifier compared the result with the request.
prevention: Add a code check at reading acceptance: when a request names a file-size or line limit, the check measures the named file in the current snapshot, adds a criterion for the limit itself, and records the measured number. The producer is then required to re-measure the file at the end and report the figure against the limit. The check also compares the reading's criteria with the request's stated outcomes and flags any outcome with no criterion.
proposed_request: Break up the 205-line status function in crates/athena-core/src/status.rs so that status.rs is under the 2000 production-line file limit. First measure status.rs production lines in the current snapshot and state the number. Split the status function into smaller functions, and move enough code into a new module (for example status/ submodules) that status.rs ends under 1500 production lines, with behavior unchanged. Acceptance: (1) status.rs has fewer than 1500 production lines, with the before and after counts reported; (2) no function in status.rs or its new modules is over 100 lines; (3) existing status tests pass unchanged; (4) cargo test, clippy and fmt are clean; (5) a changelog entry is added.
